summary: IceCure Medical Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K reporting that its Annual and Special General Meeting of Shareholders, convened November 2, 2026, was initially adjourned for lack of quorum before reconvening at 6:30 p.m. Israel time, where a quorum was present and shareholders approved all agenda items described in the proxy statement included as Exhibit 99.2 to the October 5, 2026 Form 6-K. No terms, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics are disclosed. This is a routine meeting-result notice; no special-situation or risk-arb angle applies.
